/usr/bin/cmake -E rm -f CMakeFiles/SDL2.dir/objects.a
/usr/bin/x86_64-w64-mingw32-ar qc CMakeFiles/SDL2.dir/objects.a @CMakeFiles/SDL2.dir/objects1.rsp
/usr/bin/x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc  -idirafter "/home/taiwei/code/myBeijingHell/external/SDL2/src/video/khronos"  -Wall -fno-strict-aliasing -Wdeclaration-after-statement -fvisibility=hidden -Wshadow -mmmx -m3dnow -msse -msse2 -msse3  -DSDL_BUILD_MAJOR_VERSION=2 -DSDL_BUILD_MINOR_VERSION=26 -DSDL_BUILD_MICRO_VERSION=5 -O3 -DNDEBUG -static-libgcc -shared -o SDL2.dll -Wl,--out-implib,libSDL2.dll.a -Wl,--major-image-version,2,--minor-image-version,26 -Wl,--whole-archive CMakeFiles/SDL2.dir/objects.a -Wl,--no-whole-archive @CMakeFiles/SDL2.dir/linklibs.rsp
